source.author: cic
source.text: atque hoc idem et Telamo ille declarat: ego cum genui et Theseus: futuras mecum commentabar miserias et Anaxagoras: sciebam me genuisse mortalem.
source.text_original: atque hoc idem et Telamo ille declarat: ego cum genui  et Theseus: futuras mecum commentabar miserias et Anaxagoras: sciebam me genuisse mortalem.
source.text_english: And this same point is made by that Telamon too: when I begot, and Theseus: I was planning the miseries that were to come with me, and Anaxagoras: I knew that I had begotten a mortal.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: Did I know that I had given birth to a mortal?
